update_summary:### Stage 4: Final Synthesis
After analyzing all evidence according to the Three Core Investigation Rules:

#### Findings:
1. **org.neo4j.test:neo4j-harness**  
   - **Relationship Type**: NO_RELATIONSHIP  
   - **Evidence Summary**: Neo4j Harness is a testing utility, not a successor to the embedded database. Official documentation confirms it's used exclusively for integration testing (e.g., "used to set up an embedded Neo4j instance for testing"). The modern production solution remains the official driver (`org.neo4j.driver:neo4j-java-driver`), while Testcontainers is recommended for testing.  
   - **Confidence**: High  
   - **Supporting URLs**:  
     [Spring Data Neo4j Docs](https://docs.spring.io/spring-data/neo4j/docs/5.3.5.RELEASE/reference/html/)  
     [Neo4j Community Discussion](https://community.neo4j.com/t/neo4j-harness-version-upgrade-from-3-1-0-to-4-4-26-in-scala/65785)

2. **org.neo4j.doc:neo4j-cypher-docs-parent**  
   - **Relationship Type**: NO_RELATIONSHIP  
   - **Evidence Summary**: This is documentation-focused artifact for Cypher reference materials. No evidence links it to the embedded database functionality or succession.  
   - **Confidence**: High  
   - **Supporting URLs**:  
     [GitHub Coordinates Analysis](https://github.com/jonathanlermitage/oga-maven-plugin/blob/master/maven-index-search-suspect-coordinates/suspiciousCoordinates-filtered.txt)
